LESSON: IMPORTANCE OF FEATURES IN JAIN DERASAR AND SIKH GURDWARA

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Worship (Ishwar Bhakti)
Topic 4.1: Importance Of Features In Jain Derasar and Sikh Gurdwara
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 10

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Importance Of Features In Jain Derasar and Sikh Gurdwara, part of Worship (Ishwar Bhakti) in Grade 5 HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

Key inquiry question: Why is it important to visit a place of worship? 2. What is the importance of features you see while visiting a Jain Derasar?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. identify features of place of worship,

2. collect pictures of Jain Derasar and Sikh Gurdwara from magazines/ newspapers/digital devices,

3. explain relevant features at a place of worship,

4. discuss the different features of Jain Derasar and Sikh Gurdwara,

5. take photos at the places of worship and create a montage,

6. visit places of worship to witness activities carried out at different times,

7. recite poems on features at a place of worship,

8. engage and encourage peers with special needs to recite poems that glorify the places of worship. 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. identify features of place of worship,
2. collect pictures of Jain Derasar and Sikh Gurdwara from magazines/ newspapers/digital devices,
3. explain relevant features at a place of worship,
4. discuss the different features of Jain Derasar and Sikh Gurdwara,
5. take photos at the places of worship and create a montage,
6. visit places of worship to witness activities carried out at different times,
7. recite poems on features at a place of worship,
8. engage and encourage peers with special needs to recite poems that glorify the places of worship. 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Importance Of Features In Jain Derasar and Sikh Gurdwara together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Creativity and imagination: Learner enhances networking when taking photos at the places of worship and

creating a montage using photos from the places of worship.

Values:
Responsibly: learner enhances the virtues of hard work by collecting pictures of Jain Derasar and Sikh

Gurdwara from magazines/ newspapers/digital devices.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Citizenship: Learner enhances social cohesion by visiting places of worship to witness activities carried out at

different times.

Links to other Learning Areas:
• Learner is able to relate the skill of using digital devices, newspaper and magazines to collect pictures of

Jain Derasar and Sikh Gurdwara to the skills learnt in Creative Arts.

• Learner is able to relate the skill of identifying features of places of worship to geographical skills learnt

in Social Studies.
